setup: Each case starts with a cleared rig, motors and shafts before casing placement. The two equal-speed cases leave out the second casing until the split networks settle.
sampling: Sample each settled layout six ticks after setup. For each equal-speed source join, capture six ticks after setup before inserting the second casing, then one and four ticks after insertion. Each sample records block ID and signed speed at 12 positions, and casing axis and input face for each surviving Gearbox.
